description: Store a TOTP authenticator for an account your human asked you to create or operate. Requires an approved workspace key. Provide name and one of uri (otpauth://totp), secret (Base32), or imageBase64 (PNG/JPEG QR, at most 1 MiB and one million pixels). Secrets are encrypted and never returned. Free allows 2, Pro 25, Team 100.

imageBase64.description: Canonical Base64 PNG or JPEG QR image.

name: add_authenticator
